blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models face significant efficiency challenges that stem from two distinct yet coupled sources: data redundancy and computational redundancy. While most methods focus on data redundancy by pruning visual tokens from the output of the visual encoder or computing redundancy in LLM decoders using blockwise importance, the finer-grained inter-layer representation shifts and the distribution differences within the layers themselves have not been fully explored. In this work, we comprehensively investigate this dual-level inefficiency. We posit that intermediate layer tokens from vision encoders should be considered for effective visual token pruning, as semantic focus shifts across layers, with middle-layer tokens capturing more detailed object-centric information that deeper layers may abstract away. Furthermore, we reveal the differential contributions of Attention and FFNs across distinct LLM decoder layers. Building upon these discoveries, we propose SPIDER , a training-free framework that integrates multi-layer S emantic visual token P run I ng with an a D aptive sub-lay ER skipping mechanism. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that SPIDER consistently maintains strong performance across various MLLM architectures and reduction ratios. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT-7B, SPIDER reduces FLOPs by 79 % 79\% while maintaining 96 % \% of the baseline performance.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型面临着重大的效率挑战,这些挑战来自两个不同但又相互结合的来源:数据冗余和计算冗余。 虽然大多数方法都注重通过从LLM解码器的可视编码器输出中推开可视化符号或计算冗余而使用块形重要性的数据冗余,但细纹层间代表值变化以及层内本身的分布差异尚未得到充分探索. 在这项工作中,我们全面调查这种双重效率低下的现象。 我们假设,视觉编码器的中间层符号应该被考虑为有效的可视化符号推敲,因为语义焦点会跨层移动,中间层的符号捕捉到更细的以物体为中心的信息,而更深层可能抽象掉. 此外,我们揭示了不同LLM解码层的注意力和FFN的不同贡献。 在这些发现的基础上,我们提出天基信息平台,这是一个无培训框架,将多层次的S语义视觉符号P run I ng与一个D调性子lay ER跳过机制结合起来。 实验性评价表明,天基信息平台始终保持各种多边 LLM架构和减少比率方面的良好业绩。 例如,在LLaVA-NEXT-7B上,天基信息平台将FLOP减少79% 79%,同时保持基线绩效的96%。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate visual information with powerful large language models (LLMs), achieving strong performances on various complex tasks, such as image understanding [ 1 ] , video understanding [ 2 ] , and visual reasoning [ 3 ] . However, this integration introduces significant overhead, stemming from both data redundancy in the form of lengthy visual token sequences and computational redundancy within the large-scale LLM backbone. While visual token pruning has become a dominant strategy to tackle data redundancy [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] , the computational redundancy in processing the remaining tokens through the LLM decoder has received insufficient attention. In this work, we argue that data redundancy and computational redundancy can be combined, and each requires a more fine-grained pruning strategy.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)将视觉信息与强大的大语言模型(LLMs)融合在一起,实现对各种复杂任务的强性表现,如图像理解[1],视频理解[2],视觉推理[3]. 然而,这种整合引入了可观的间接费用,这既源于数据冗余,其形式是长长的视觉符号序列,又源于大型LLM主干线内的计算冗余。 虽然视觉信使搜索已经成为解决数据冗余[4,5,6]的主导策略,但通过LLM解码器处理剩余信使时的计算冗余没有得到足够的关注. 在这部作品中,我们主张数据冗余和计算冗余可以合并,每部作品都需要更精细的修剪策略.

blocks.en: First, on the data redundancy front, most state-of-the-art token pruners [ 6 , 5 , 4 ] rely exclusively on the feature maps from the final layer of the vision encoder to compute token importance. However, our empirical analysis suggests that this “last-layer-only” approach suffers from a significant semantic focus shift. As illustrated in Fig. 1 , while the deep layers of a Vision Transformer (ViT) excel at capturing abstract, global context, the middle layers often retain superior object-centric details essential for fine-grained tasks like counting or precise localization. By discarding middle-layer insights, present pruning methods risk eliminating critical visual fragments that are semantically “diluted” in the final layer but vital for accurate reasoning.
blocks.zh: 首先,在数据冗余战线上,大多数最先进的代号刷卡器[6,5,4]完全依靠从视觉编码器最后一层的特征图来计算代号重要性. 然而,我们的实证分析表明,这种“最后一级”的做法有重大的语义重点转变。 如图1所示,虽然视觉变形器(ViT)的深层擅长捕捉抽象的全局背景,但中层往往保留对计数或精确本地化等精细刻度任务至关重要的高级对象中心细节. 通过抛弃中层的洞察力,目前的探究方法有可能消除尖锐的视觉碎片,这些碎片在最后一层中被“稀释”,但对准确推理至关重要。

blocks.en: Second, on the computational redundancy front, existing acceleration methods primarily focus on coarse-grained block-skipping [ 7 , 8 ] . These approaches indiscriminately bypass entire LLM decoder blocks, ignoring the internal heterogeneity of the decoder. Our diagnostic experiments reveal a functional divergence between sub-layers: the Attention and Feed-forward Network (FFN) components contribute unequally to the refinement of visual tokens across the decoding stages. This finding motivates a more adaptive and fine-grained skipping strategy than treating blocks as monolithic units.
blocks.zh: 第二,在计算冗余方面,现有的加速度方法主要侧重于粗重的阻塞抽取[7,8]. 这些方法不分青红皂白地绕过整个LLM解码器块,忽略了解码器的内部异质性. 我们的诊断实验揭示了子层之间的功能差异:注意力和Feed-forward Network(FFN)组件在解码阶段对视觉符号的完善做出了不平等的贡献. 这一发现激励了一种比将区块作为单质单元处理更适应性和精细的跳过策略.

blocks.en: Based on these findings, we propose SPIDER, a novel, training-free framework to improve MLLM inference efficiency. It is built on two core mechanisms: Multi-layer semantic token pruning (MSV-Prune) : This strategy uses tokens from both deep and middle layers of the visual encoder for semantic clustering and similarity computation. Adaptive sub-layer skipping (ASL-Skip) : This strategy accumulates a skippability score to determine which retained visual tokens should perform layer skipping and at which layer to skip, and an offline sub-layer contribution score ( SLC \mathrm{SLC} ) to decide which specific sub-layer (Attention or FFN) to skip in subsequent LLM decoder layers for skipped tokens.
blocks.zh: 基于这些结论,我们提议天基信息平台是一个新的、无培训的框架,以提高MLLM推论的效率。 它建立在两个核心机制上: 多层语义符号修饰(MSV-Prune) : 这种策略使用来自视觉编码器深层和中层的符号进行语义集群和相似性计算. 适应性子层跳过(ASL-Skip) : 此策略会累积一个可跳转的分数,以确定哪些保留了的视觉符号会进行层跳转,在哪个层跳转,以及一个离线的子层贡献分数(SLC\mathrm{SLC}),以决定哪个子层(Attenty或FFN)会在之后的 LLM 解码器层跳过,用于跳转的符号.

blocks.en:
A key perspective behind SPIDER is that the utility of a visual token changes with depth across the full multimodal inference pipeline. Accordingly, MSV-Prune determines which tokens should enter the decoder at all, while ASL-Skip determines how much computation each retained token still needs as decoding progresses. SPIDER is therefore a unified utility-allocation framework rather than a simple combination of two independent acceleration modules. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We explore the semantic focus shift across vision encoder layers, and propose multi-layer semantic token pruning, considering middle and deep layer tokens. • We quantify the fine-grained redundancy in attention and FFN sub-layers of MLLM decoders, and propose adaptive sub-layer skipping to decide whether a retained visual token should skip, when to skip, and skip which part of the layers. • We propose SPIDER, a unified training-free framework that
jointly addresses encoder-side token redundancy and decoder-side computational redundancy, significantly reducing inference cost across various MLLM architectures while maintaining comparable performance.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: II Related Works
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工程

blocks.en: II-A Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs)
blocks.zh: II-A 多种大型语文模式

blocks.en: MLLMs have emerged as a dominant paradigm for unified vision–language understanding and generation, leveraging the strong priors of large language models (LLMs) to interpret and reason over visual inputs [ 9 , 10 ] . Pioneering architectures such as LLaVA [ 10 ] , BLIP-2 [ 11 ] , and MiniGPT-4 [ 12 ] typically employ a frozen vision encoder (e.g., CLIP ViT) to extract image features, which are then projected into the LLM’s textual embedding space via a trainable connector. This design enables zero-shot or few-shot multimodal inference through natural language prompts, achieving remarkable performance across diverse tasks—from visual question answering to image captioning.
blocks.zh: MLLMs已成为统一视觉-语言理解和生成的主导范式,利用大语言模型(LLMs)的强大前身来解释和理性而不是视觉投入[9,10]. LLAVA[10],BLIP-2[11],MiniGPT-4[12]等先行建筑一般使用冷冻的视觉编码器(如CLIP ViT)来提取图像特性,然后通过可列车连接器投射到LLM的文本嵌入空间中. 这种设计能够通过自然语言提示进行零射或几射的多式联运推论,在从视觉问题回答到图像标题等各种任务中取得显著的性能。

blocks.en: Beyond general-purpose benchmarks, MLLMs have been successfully specialized for domain-critical applications. For instance, EmoVerse [ 13 ] is specifically designed for affective computing, integrating emotion-aware visual reasoning through multi-task training to jointly handle sentiment analysis, emotion recognition, facial expression interpretation, and emotion cause inference. While MedTVT [ 14 ] integrates clinical multimodal data and medical knowledge graphs to enable interpretable, evidence-based multi-disease diagnosis through chain-of-evidence reasoning. These advances underscore the potential of MLLMs in high-stakes scenarios where accuracy, reliability, and contextual grounding are paramount.
blocks.zh: 在普通用途基准之外,MLLMs成功地专门用于域关键应用。 例如,EmoVerse [13] 专门设计为情感计算,通过多任务训练整合情感感知视觉推理,共同处理情绪分析,情感识别,面部表情解释,以及情感诱因推论. 虽然MedTVT[14]将临床多模式数据和医学知识图集成,通过证据链推理使可解释的循证多病诊断成为可能. 这些进展突出表明,在准确性、可靠性和背景基础都至关重要的高风险假设中,微额供资和微额供资的潜在作用。

blocks.en: However, the computational overhead of MLLMs remains a fundamental barrier to real-world deployment. High-resolution images often yield thousands of visual tokens after patch embedding, drastically inflating sequence length and memory consumption during LLM decoding [ 15 , 6 ] . This issue is exacerbated in video understanding [ 16 , 17 , 2 ] , where temporal redundancy across frames compounds token explosion. Consequently, even state-of-the-art MLLMs struggle with latency and scalability in edge or interactive settings, necessitating principled efficiency mechanisms that preserve semantic fidelity without retraining.
blocks.zh: 然而,MLLM的计算间接费用仍然是现实世界部署的根本障碍。 高分辨率图像往往在补丁嵌入后产生数千个视觉符号,在LLM解码过程中急剧膨胀序列长度和内存消耗[15,6]. 视频理解 [16, 17, 2] 使这一问题更为严重,因为相框间的时间冗余性化合物发生象征性爆炸。 因此,即使是最新水平的MLLMs在边缘或互动环境中也难以适应和适应,因此需要建立原则性的效率机制,在不进行再培训的情况下保持语义忠诚。

blocks.en: II-B Reducing Redundancy in MLLMs
blocks.zh: II-B 减少小额供资和微型企业的裁员

blocks.en: While MLLMs have achieved remarkable success, their huge computational cost hinders scalable deployment. Existing inference optimizations primarily fall into two categories: token pruning and layer skipping.
blocks.zh: 虽然MLLMs取得了显著的成功,但其巨大的计算成本阻碍了可扩展的部署. 现有的推论优化主要分为两类:符号推算和层跳.

blocks.en: Token pruning has gained wide attention due to the high redundancy of visual tokens, which dominate input sequences. Some efforts focused on compressing visual tokens into compact representations [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] , but requiring additional training. Other training-free methods leverage text-visual attention within the LLM to identify less important visual tokens [ 4 , 5 , 21 ] . However, studies like Vispruner [ 6 ] , VisionZip [ 22 ] , VTC-CLS [ 23 ] , and HiPrune [ 24 ] argue against the sole reliance on text-visual attention due to positional bias, advocating for visual cues. A common limitation across most token pruning methods is their focus on pruning from the final output, neglecting the multi-layer semantic information inherent in the vision encoder.
blocks.zh: Token pruning由于视觉符号的高度冗余而获得了广泛的关注,它主导了输入序列. 一些努力侧重于将视觉标志压缩为紧凑的表示[18、19、20],但需要更多的培训。 其他无培训方法利用LLM内部的文字-视觉关注来识别不太重要的视觉符号[4,5,21]. 然而,维斯普鲁纳[6],Vispruner[22],VTC-CLS[23],HiPrune[24]等研究则反对由于立场偏倚而只依赖文本-视觉关注,主张视觉提示. 多数象征性的修饰方法的共同局限在于它们注重从最终输出中修饰,忽略了视觉编码器固有的多层语义信息.

blocks.en: Layer skipping addresses the inherent layer redundancy in MLLMs, as observed by ShortV [ 25 ] . While some layer skipping approaches involve additional training [ 26 , 27 , 28 ] , our focus remains on training-free methods. ShortV [ 25 ] , for instance, identifies and replaces less effective layers with sparse versions where visual tokens remain frozen. However, these methods are not fine-grained enough since they often aggressively replace entire LLM layers for all visual tokens, overlooking token and sub-layer importance variance .
blocks.zh: 跳过层处理MLLMs中固有的层冗余,如ShortV [25]所观察到的那样. 虽然某些层次的跳过方法涉及额外的培训[26、27、28],但我们的重点仍然是无培训方法。 例如,ShortV [25] 识别效果较差的层,并以视觉符号仍然冻结的稀疏版本取代. 然而,这些方法不够精细,因为它们常常积极地取代所有视觉标志的LLM层,俯瞰标志和亚层的重要性差异。

blocks.en: Different from previous works, we use the semantic information from middle and deep layer tokens for token pruning. Besides, we systematically analyze the contribution difference of attention and FFN modules in the LLM decoder and adopt a more fine-grained sub-layer skipping mechanism.
blocks.zh: 与之前的作品不同,我们使用中深层符号的语义信息来进行符号冲洗. 此外,我们系统分析LLM解码器中注意力和FFN模块的贡献差异,并采用更精细的子层跳动机制.

blocks.en: Unlike prior work that treats token pruning and layer skipping as independent problems, SPIDER addresses them as two phases of a single depth-dependent utility-allocation problem: visual token utility shifts across encoder layers motivate multi-layer pruning before decoding, while the gradual semantic convergence of retained tokens during decoding motivates adaptive sub-layer skipping. Concretely, unlike previous token pruning methods, we explicitly consider the semantic differences between middle and deep layers of the vision encoder, leveraging a multi-layer semantic clustering approach to achieve more comprehensive token pruning. Furthermore, diverging from coarse-grained layer skipping strategies, SPIDER introduces a sub-layer skipping mechanism that adaptively determines whether a retained visual token should skip, when to skip, and which sub-layer to skip. The two modules are thus mutually motivated by the same depth-dependent view of token utility, rather than being independently assembled.
blocks.zh: 与以往将符号寻觅和图层跳过作为独立问题处理的工作不同,天基信息平台将它们作为单一深度依赖的效用分配问题的两个阶段处理:可视化符号的功能跨编码层转移在解码前激发多层的寻觅,而解码过程中保留符号的逐渐语义趋同则激发了适应性子层跳过. 具体地说,与之前的代号调试方法不同,我们明确考虑视觉编码器中层和深层的语义差异,利用多层语义分类法来实现更全面的代号调试. 此外,与粗糙层跳过策略不同,天基信息平台引入了一个子层跳过机制,可适应性地决定所保留的视觉标志是否跳过,跳过的时间,以及跳过哪个子层。 因此,这两个模块是相互激励的,因为对象征性效用有同样的深度依赖,而不是独立组装。

blocks.en: III Key Findings
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 主要调查结果

blocks.en: III-A Semantic Shift across Vision Encoder
blocks.zh: 三-A 跨视觉编码器的语义变化

blocks.en: We visualize the semantic focus shift and the distribution of the top 25 % \% attentive tokens across CLIP vision encoder layers in Figure 1 . t-SNE embeddings across layers show a gradual shift in semantic clustering, with middle layers bridging distinct visual concepts. Notably, middle-layer tokens focus more on key object regions, yielding higher key object coverage ratios R ∗ R^{*} compared to early and deep layers. To quantify this systematically, we compute the average R ∗ R^{*} over 100 sampled evaluation images at three representative layers of the 24-layer CLIP ViT: 11.28 % 11.28\% at layer 1 (early), 29.65 % 29.65\% at layer 12 (middle), and 15.83 % 15.83\% at layer 24 (deep), confirming a clear middle-layer peak consistent with the per-example results in Fig. 1 . Deep layers, while capturing broader scene regions, risk missing critical object information. This suggests that effective token pruning should leverage both middle- and deep-layer features, not solely the deepest layer.
blocks.zh: 在图1中,我们可视化了语义焦点的转移以及前25%的注意符号的分布。 t-SNE跨层嵌入显示语义组分的逐渐转变,中间层连接了不同的视觉概念. 值得注意的是,中层标志更注重于关键对象区域,与早期和深层相比,关键对象覆盖率R****=更高。 为了系统地量化这一点,我们计算了24层CLIP VIT中三个代表性层的平均R ∗ = 100以上抽样评价图像:第1层(早期)为11.28%,第12层(中层)为29.65%,第24层(深层)为15.83%,证实了与图1中每个实例结果一致的明显的中层峰值。 深层在捕捉更广泛的场景区域的同时,还有可能丢失关键物体信息. 这表明,有效的信物钻探应利用中层和深层两种特征,而不仅仅是最深层。

blocks.en: III-B Sub-Layer Redundancy in MLLMs
blocks.zh: 三-B MLLMs中分机冗余

blocks.en: To quantify sub-layer redundancy for specific tokens, we introduce two sparse layers: VSkip-Attn and VSkip-FFN . In the VSkip-Attn layer, visual tokens do not function as queries, acting solely as keys and values. In the VSkip-FFN layer, the visual token input to the FFN is directly bypassed.
blocks.zh: 为了量化特定符号的子层冗余,我们引入了两个稀疏的层:VSkip-Attn和VSkip-FFN. 在VSkip-Attn层中,视觉符号不作为查询功能,仅作为密钥和值. 在VSkip-FFN层中,直接绕过对FFN的视觉符号输入.

blocks.en:
We propose the Sub-Layer Contribution (SLC) score to quantify a sub-layer’s impact on the model’s final prediction. The SLC is calculated as the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the output logits of the original model and a modified one where a specific sub-layer’s operation is selectively bypassed.
Specifically, to measure the contribution, we simulate skipping a sub-layer (e.g., attention or FFN) for a subset of tokens X X at a given layer i i by preventing their hidden states from being updated by that sub-layer. We then define 𝐒𝐋𝐂 i , attn X \mathbf{SLC}_{i,\mathrm{attn}}^{X} and 𝐒𝐋𝐂 i , ffn X \mathbf{SLC}_{i,\mathrm{ffn}}^{X} as the KL divergence when the self-attention or FFN sub-layers are skipped for tokens X X in layer i i , respectively. A lower 𝐒𝐋𝐂 \mathbf{SLC} value indicates less influence on the final output, making the sub-layer a stronger skip candidate. For each layer, we identify the least impactful module by comparing the two sub-layers after the per-module normalization introduced in Eq. (5), and replace modules with the corresponding sparse layers in order of decreasing skippability.

具体地说,为了衡量贡献,我们模拟跳过一个子层(如注意或FFN),用于给定层的子集X X i,防止其隐藏状态被该子层更新. 然后将 SLC i, attn X\ mathbf{ SLC}_{i,\mathrm{attn}}^{X} 和 SLC i, ffn X\mathbf{ SLC}_{i,\mathrm{ffn}}^{X} ) 定义为 KL 差异, 当自觉或 FFN 子层在 i i 层中分别跳过标记 X X X 。 一个更低的SLC\mathbf{SLC}值表明对最终输出的影响较小,使子层成为更强大的跳跃候选. 对于每一层,我们通过比较Eq(5)中引入的每个模块正常化后的两个子层来识别影响最小的模块,并将模块替换为相应的稀疏层,以降低跳动性.

blocks.en: IV Method
blocks.zh: 四 方法

blocks.en: Our training-free framework is illustrated in Figure 4 . The input image first undergoes multi-layer semantic visual token pruning to reduce data redundancy, and the retained tokens are then fed to the LLM decoder for adaptive sub-layer skipping . The two components are designed to be coupled rather than independent. MSV-Prune determines which visual tokens should enter the decoder at all by removing semantically redundant tokens before decoding, while ASL-Skip further determines how much computation each retained token still needs as decoding progresses. In this way, SPIDER allocates computation across the full multimodal inference pipeline according to the evolving utility of visual tokens. Details are as follows.
blocks.zh: 我们的无培训框架见图4。 输入图像首先经过多层语义视觉符号的修饰以减少数据冗余,所保留的符号随后被输入LLM解码器用于适应子层跳过. 这两个组成部分的设计是结合而不是独立的。 MSV-Prune通过在解码前移除大量冗余的符号来确定哪些视觉符号应输入解码器,而ASL-Skip则进一步确定每个保留符号在解码过程中仍然需要多少计算. 这样,天基信息平台根据视觉信号的不断演变的效用,在整个多式联运推论管道中分配计算。 详情如下。

blocks.en: IV-B Adaptive Sub-Layer Skipping
blocks.zh: IV-B 适应性亚层跳过

blocks.en: Even after token pruning, significant computational redundancy persists within the MLLM decoder. While prior work has explored coarse-grained layer skipping, this often incurs performance degradation. We observe that sub-layers (i.e., self-attention and FFN) within each decoder block contribute unequally to the final output (Fig. 3 ). This motivates our fine-grained, adaptive sub-layer skipping policy, which dynamically bypasses less critical sub-layers for specific tokens. The decision process is guided by a hybrid mechanism, combining an online, per-token skippability score with an offline, per-layer sub-layer contribution score.
blocks.zh: 即使在信物校验后,在MLLM解码器内部仍然存在大量的计算冗余. 虽然以前的工作曾探索过粗糙的地层跳过,但这往往会造成性能退化。 我们注意到,每个解码器块内的子层(即自觉和FFN)对最终输出的贡献不平等(图3). 这激励着我们精细的,适应性的子层跳过政策,它动态地绕过对特定代币不太关键的子层. 决策过程以混合机制为指南,将在线的每秒跳跃性分数与离线的每层子层贡献分数相结合.

Datasets. We evaluate on various multimodal benchmarks, including GQA [ 30 ] , VQAv2 [ 31 ] ,
MME [ 32 ] , TextVQA [ 33 ] , POPE [ 34 ] , MMB [ 35 ] , MMVet [ 36 ] , MMStar [ 37 ] and DocVQA [ 38 ] . VQAv2 [ 31 ] evaluates visual recognition via open-ended questions on 265k MSCOCO images, with adversarially balanced answers to reduce language bias. We use the test-dev set (107k image-question pairs), scored against 10 human answers. GQA [ 30 ] tests structured reasoning using scene graph–generated questions on Visual Genome images. Evaluation is based on accuracy over 12.6k test-dev pairs. TextVQA [ 33 ] requires models to read and reason about OCR text in Open Images (e.g., signs, labels). Evaluated on 5k validation pairs. POPE [ 34 ] measures object hallucination in MLLMs by querying object presence in MSCOCO images, reporting average F1 across three sampling strategies (8.9k pairs). MME [ 32 ] assesses perception (OCR, object attributes, fine-grained recognition) via 14 binary subtasks; we report the perception score on 2,374 pairs. MMB [ 35 ] offers a hierarchical multimodal evaluation with multiple-choice questions across perception and reasoning. Both English (4,377) and Chinese (4,329) versions are used. MM-Vet [ 36 ] integrates six core capabilities (e.g., OCR, spatial reasoning, math) into 16 tasks, evaluated by ChatGPT on 218 diverse samples. MMStar [ 37 ] provides a clean, human-curated benchmark of 1,500 visually dependent samples with minimal data leakage, measuring true multimodal gains across 6 capabilities and 18 axes. DocVQA [ 38 ] focuses on document understanding, requiring fine-grained textual and spatial reasoning over 50k questions on 12k+ document images.

blocks.en: Implementation Details for Specific Architectures. For Qwen-series models with a PatchMerger, MSV-Prune extracts intermediate and final ViT hidden states and passes both through the same PatchMerger to obtain post-merger representations at two semantic depths. All importance computation and token selection are performed on these post-merger tokens, ensuring no conflict with the spatial merging structure. DeepStack feature tensors share the same token layout as the main stream by design, so the retained token indices apply to them directly. ASL-Skip operates entirely within the LLM decoder on the retained post-merger tokens and is independent of the vision encoder structure, so no additional adaptation is needed for Qwen-series models.
blocks.zh: 具体架构的实施细节. 对于带有PatchMerger的Quen系列模型,MSV-Prune提取中间和最终的ViT隐藏状态,并同时通过同一PatchMerger,以在两个语义深度获得合并后的表示. 所有这些重要的计算和符号选择都是在这些合并后的符号上进行的,确保与空间合并结构不发生冲突。 DeepStack功能的百合器通过设计与主流共用相同的符号布局,因此保留符号指数直接适用于它们. ASL-Skip在保留后的合并后符号上完全在LLM解码器内运行,并且独立于视觉编码器结构,因此Quen系列模型不需要额外的修改.

blocks.en: For LLaVA-NeXT with AnyRes, MSV-Prune is applied independently to each tile in the shared ViT feature space before the multi-modal projector. The base tile and all local tiles share the same pruning rule and token budget, with no extra quota reserved for the global tile. Per-tile masks are propagated together with the standard AnyRes reshape and unpadding operations, and the retained base-tile and local-tile tokens are then concatenated into the flat visual sequence consumed by the LLM decoder.
blocks.zh: 对于带有AnyRes的LLaVA-NEXT,MSV-Prune在多式投影仪之前,在共享的ViT特性空间中独立应用于每个瓦片. 基瓦和所有当地瓦片共用相同的螺旋规则和象征性预算,没有为全球瓦片预留额外配额. 单瓦口罩与标准的AnyRes重塑和不铺设操作一起传播,保留下来的底瓦和局部瓦的代币随后被调整成LLM解码器消耗的平面视觉序列.

blocks.en: For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, the number of visual tokens is input-dependent, so SPIDER is configured by the visual retention ratio R v R_{v} rather than a fixed retained-token number. The two settings in Table V use R v = 0.5 R_{v}=0.5 and R v = 0.4 R_{v}=0.4 , respectively, and are chosen to approximately match the compared baselines in end-to-end FLOPs. ASL-Skip is token-adaptive rather than layer-fixed; empirically, most retained visual tokens begin skipping after the first four decoder layers, with an overall skipped-token proportion of around 70 % 70\% and 60 % 60\% , respectively. FLOPs are measured over the full multimodal pipeline under the same prompt and image preprocessing setup.

blocks.en:
We apply SPIDER to the classic LLaVA-1.5 and LLaVA-NeXT models and comprehensively compare against prior approaches.
As shown in Table I , SPIDER consistently matches or surpasses baselines across multiple benchmarks at similar or lower FLOPs, outperforming other training‑free methods and achieving the best trade‑off between efficiency and performance. Notably, even under a relatively aggressive FLOPs reduction ratio to 20 % 20\% , SPIDER applied on LLaVA-NeXT-7B retains 96.09 % 96.09\% of the overall performance, whereas skip-layer-based baselines such as ShortV degrade substantially. On challenging benchmarks such as MMVet and MMStar, which demand strong spatial awareness and reasoning capabilities, SPIDER maintains competitive accuracy, underscoring its robustness under high compression.
blocks.zh:
我们把天基信息平台应用于典型的LLaVA-1.5和LLaVA-NEXT模型,并与以往的做法进行全面比较。
如表一所示,天基信息平台在类似或较低水平的外地业务方案上一贯匹配或超过多个基准的基线,优于其他无培训方法,并在效率和业绩之间实现最佳权衡。 值得注意的是,即便在相对积极的FLOPs削减比为20% 20 QQ的情况下,在LLAVA-NEXT-7B上应用的天基信息平台仍然保留了总体绩效的96.09% 96.09 QQ,而ShortV等基于跳层的基线则大幅降解。 在MMVet和MMStar等需要强大空间意识和推理能力的具有挑战性的基准上,天基信息平台保持了竞争性的准确性,强调了其在高压缩条件下的稳健性。

blocks.en: More specifically, we ablate the two core components of SPIDER separately: MSV-Prune in Table II and ASL-Skip in Table III .
blocks.zh: 更具体地说,我们分别放弃天基信息平台的两个核心组成部分:表二中的MSV-Prune和表三中的ASL-Skip。

blocks.en: Table II shows that MSV-Prune consistently surpasses SOTA pruners across all retention ratios. This confirms that relying solely on the vision encoder’s last layer introduces a semantic focus shift where more fine-grained object-centric information is sacrificed for abstract global context. By incorporating middle-layer features as semantic anchors, MSV-Prune ensures a more holistic representation of the visual scene, which is reflected in the significantly higher scores on OCR-centric tasks like TextVQA.
blocks.zh: 表二显示,在所有保留比率中,MSV-Prune一直超过SOTA的分数。 这证明,仅仅依靠视觉编码器的最后一层就引入了语义焦点的转变,即为了抽象的全球背景而牺牲更精细的以物体为中心的信息。 MSV-Prune通过将中层特征作为语义主播,确保了视觉场景的更整体的体现,这体现在像TextVQA这样的OCR中心任务上的显著更高的分数上.

blocks.en: Table III reveals that ASL-Skip preserves overall performance more effectively than existing layer-pruning methods at the same computational cost, underscoring the importance of fine-grained sub-layer skipping. Even under identical FLOPs ratios, non-adaptive partial FFN skipping still incurs a 2% accuracy drop compared to ASL-Skip, while skipping all FFN sub-layers leads to nearly 30% degradation. These results indicate that skipping attention sub-layers is significantly less harmful than skipping FFNs, and that adaptive skipping (ASL-Skip) is the optimal strategy.
blocks.zh: 表三显示,ASL-Skip以同样的计算成本比现有的层推法更有效地保存了整体性能,强调了精细分层跳过的重要性. 即使在相同的FLOPs比下,非适应性部分FFN跳转与ASL-Skip相比仍然会出现2%的精度下降,而跳过所有FFN子层会导致近30%的降解. 这些结果表明,跳过关注子层比跳过FFN的危害要小得多,适应性跳过(ASL-Skip)是最佳策略.

we further compare against more recent methods including PruneSID [ 40 ] ,
IVC-Prune [ 41 ] , iLLaVA [ 42 ] , and ERASE [ 43 ] .

55% and 45% TFLOPs settings, respectively. At matched compute, SPIDER is on par
with the strongest recent baseline in aggregate accuracy, while leading on ChartQA
and DocVQA under both settings and also obtaining the best GQA score at the 45%
TFLOPs setting. These results confirm that the redundancy patterns targeted by
SPIDER, namely the semantic focus shift across vision encoder layers and the sub-layer heterogeneity within the LLM decoder, are intrinsic properties of the MLLM paradigm that generalize across model families rather than being artifacts of specific architectures.

blocks.en: Beyond its training-free mode, SPIDER adapts to a training-aware framework for performance enhancement. Table VI shows results after fine-tuning on LLaVA-1.5-7B using LoRA for 1 epoch with 665K instruction data, following the same training setting as LLaVA-PruMerge [ 20 ] . Notably, the training-free SPIDER already matches PruMerge+, which requires fine-tuning, under the aggregate metric of Eq. (7) (both 99.0 % 99.0\% ), leading on POPE ( 84.8 84.8 vs. 84.0 84.0 ) and TextVQA ( 57.4 57.4 vs. 57.1 57.1 ) while trailing on MMB ( 63.9 63.9 vs. 64.9 64.9 ); post-training refinement then elevates SPIDER to 99.5 % 99.5\% .

blocks.en: V-C Qualitative Results
blocks.zh: V-C 定性结果

blocks.en: Figure 7 shows MSV‑Prune retains semantically critical tokens, while ASL‑Skip progressively skips less informative ones. Even at aggressive skip rates, core semantics are maintained, enabling accurate scene and object queries.
blocks.zh: 图7显示MSV‐Prune保留了显要的标志,而ASL‐Skip则逐渐跳过信息较少的标志. 即使在激烈的跳过速率下,核心语义也会得到维护,从而能够进行准确的场景和对象查询.

blocks.en: We additionally explore the extent of knowledge boundary drift caused by SPIDER via conducting a fine-grained instance-level analysis on the POPE test set using LLaVA-1.5-7B with our SPIDER method (at 56 % \% of original FLOPs). Accuracy improves from 85.9 % \% to 86.6 % \% , reflecting a net gain: the number of originally incorrect predictions corrected by SPIDER exceeds the number of originally correct ones flipped to wrong by 0.7 % \% . Qualitative examples are provided in Fig. 5 . This gain stems from SPIDER’s retention of mid-layer tokens encoding object-centric regions, which enhances discriminative grounding and reduces false positives—particularly in hallucination-sensitive queries.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还利用天基信息平台的方法,对使用LLaVA-1.5-7B的POPE测试组进行了精细的示例分析(占原始FLOP的56%),从而探索了天基信息平台造成的知识边界漂移程度。 准确性从85.9% \%提高到86.6% \%,反映了净收益:天基信息平台更正的最初不正确的预测数超过原先翻转错的预测数的0.7% \%。 图5提供了定性实例。 这一收益源于天基信息平台保留中层符号编码以物体为中心的区域,这加强了歧视性的地基定位,减少了虚假的阳性——特别是在对幻觉敏感的查询中。

blocks.en: V-D Efficiency Analysis
blocks.zh: V-D 效率分析

blocks.en: Figure 8 demonstrates the efficiency gains of SPIDER across varying token reduction ratios on LLaVA-1.5-7B. As the number of retained visual tokens decreases from 576 to 128, both prefill and decode latencies are significantly reduced—prefill latency drops from 67.4 ms to 48.2 ms (a 28.5% reduction), and decode latency decreases from 23.1 ms to 20.6 ms (a 10.8% reduction). Concurrently, throughput increases from 43.3 to 45.2 tokens per second, indicating improved inference speed under lower computational load. These results highlight SPIDER’s ability to achieve substantial latency reduction and higher throughput while maintaining strong semantic fidelity, as evidenced by its consistent performance in downstream tasks even at aggressive token pruning rates. This balance between efficiency and accuracy makes SPIDER suitable for real-time vision-language applications where low-latency responses are essential.
blocks.zh: 图8显示了天基信息平台在LLaVA-1.5-7B上各种象征性削减比率上的效率收益。 随着保留视觉标志的数量从576个减少到128个,预填和解码延迟都大大减少——预填延迟从67.4 ms降至48.2 ms(减少28.5%),解码延迟从23.1 ms降至20.6 ms(减少10.8%)。 同时,吞吐量从每秒43.3个令牌增加到45.2个令牌,表明在较低的计算负载下推算速度得到提高. 这些成果突出表明,天基信息平台有能力在保持强烈语义忠诚的同时,大幅度地减少潜伏性并增加吞吐量,这表现在其在下游任务中的一贯表现,甚至以积极象征性的速率。 这种效率和准确性之间的平衡使天基信息平台适合实时视觉语言应用,因为低相关性的对策至关重要。

blocks.en: The larger gain in prefill relative to decoding is expected: prefill computation scales directly with sequence length and is dominated by parallel matrix operations, whereas autoregressive decoding processes one token at a time and is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache access and memory bandwidth rather than arithmetic throughput. For ASL-Skip, the token-level dynamic sparsity introduced by our method is irregular and input-dependent, which standard dense GPU kernels cannot fully exploit without hardware-aware sparse implementations. We note this as a current practical limitation and discuss token regrouping and sparse kernel support as directions for future decode-stage acceleration.
blocks.zh: 与解码相比,预填收益较大是预期的:预填计算尺度直接以序列长度为主,以平行矩阵操作为主,而自动递归解码过程一次一个符号,越来越多地被KV-cache访问和内存带宽而不是算术吞吐量束缚. 对ASL-Skip来说,我们的方法引入的符号级动态sparsity是不规则的和依赖输入的,没有硬件意识的稀疏执行,标准密集的GPU内核就无法充分利用. 我们注意到这是目前的实际限制,并讨论象征性地重新组合和稀少的内核支助,作为今后解码阶段加速的方向。

blocks.en: V-E Comparison with Magnitude Pruning
blocks.zh: V- E 与 Magnitude Pruning 的比较

blocks.en: Prior work has shown that token pruning can induce knowledge boundary drift, which means instances once answered correctly may become incorrect after pruning, and vice versa, posing risks in applications requiring reliable responses to critical queries. To address this, we go beyond conventional benchmarks and perform an instance-level analysis of SPIDER’s semantic fidelity on the POPE test set using LLaVA-1.5-7B at 56% of original FLOPs. Accuracy improves from 85.9% to 86.6%, a net gain of 0.7%, as SPIDER corrects more originally wrong predictions than it flips correct ones. This stems from its retention of mid-layer tokens encoding object-centric regions, enhancing discriminative grounding and reducing false positives, especially in hallucination-sensitive queries. We also compare SPIDER with magnitude pruning: for each layer ℓ \ell and visual token i i , we compute L1 norms of attention and FFN outputs, average them into layer-wise scores M Attn ​ ( ℓ ) M_{\text{Attn}}(\ell) and M FFN ​ ( ℓ ) M_{\text{FFN}}(\ell) , and prune the lower-magnitude sub-module to obtain a magnitude-pruned LLaVA. KL divergence between per-layer logits of the pruned and original models quantifies post-pruning distortion. As shown in Figure 6 , SPIDER achieves lower KL divergence, confirming its superior layer-skipping strategy with minimal degradation.
blocks.zh: 先前的研究表明,象征性的搜索可以诱发知识边界漂移,这意味着一旦正确回答就可能发生错误,反之亦然,对需要可靠答复关键询问的应用程序造成风险。 为了解决这一问题,我们超越了传统的基准,在使用LLaVA-1.5-7B的POPE测试集上对天基信息平台的语义忠诚度进行了实例级分析,按原始FLOP的56%进行。 准确性从85.9%提高到86.6%,净收益为0.7%,因为天基信息平台纠正了原先错误的预测,而不是正确的预测。 这是因为它保留了中层符号编码以物体为中心的区域,加强了歧视性的地基定位和减少假阳性,特别是在对幻觉敏感的询问中. 我们还将天基信息平台与规模推算比较:对于每层l\ell和视觉符号ii,我们计算L1的注意力规范和FFN输出,平均分数为分数M Attn (l) M_Text{Attn}}(\ell)和M FFN (l) M_Text{FFN}}(\ell),并将低宽分模块加压以获得规模推算的LLAVA。 KL 被套用模型的每层对数与原始模型之间的差数可量化后套用扭曲. 如图6所示,天基信息平台实现了较低的KL差异,证实了其优异的分层测量策略,其降解程度最低。

blocks.en: Ablation on MSV-Prune (Table VII ). Under a fixed token budget (1920 tokens, r = 0.7 r=0.7 ), removing any component of MSV-Prune (semantic clustering, middle-layer tokens, or similarity scores S i ​ j S_{ij} ) reduces accuracy, highlighting the importance of modeling semantic shifts across layers. Notably, discarding middle-layer tokens hurts fine-grained tasks like OCR (e.g., TextVQA) more severely, and using only middle-layer tokens to compute intra-cluster similarity helps extracting object-centric cues. Replacing cosine similarity in S i ​ j S_{ij} with MSE or KL divergence also degrades performance: MSE is sensitive to non-semantic magnitude differences [ 44 ] , and KL divergence may not be the most appropriate choice here, as the layer features do not naturally form valid probability distributions. The full model (“All Equipped”) achieves the best average accuracy.
blocks.zh: 关于MSV-Prune的注释(表七)。 在固定的符号预算(1920个符号,r = 0.7 r = 0.7)下,去除MSV-Prune的任何组件(语义集群,中层符号,或相似性得分S i j S_{ij})会降低精度,突出跨层的语义转换模型的重要性. 值得注意的是,丢弃中层符号会更严重地伤害OCR(如TextVQA)等精致的任务,仅使用中层符号来计算集群内相似性有助于提取以对象为中心的提示. 用 MSE 或 KL 偏差取代 Si j S_{ij 中的 余弦相似性也会降低性能 : MSE对非语义的星等差异[44]很敏感,这里KL差异可能不是最合适的选择,因为地层特征不会自然形成有效的概率分布. 完整的模型(“All Equipped”)达到最佳平均准确性。

blocks.en: Ablation on Anchor Token Ratio in MSV-Prune (Table IX ). We perform a fine-grained ablation on the anchor token ratio to characterize its influence on model performance. The results reveal a clear non-monotonic trend: completely disabling anchor tokens (ratio = 0) incurs substantial drops in accuracy across all benchmarks (e.g., − 2.6 -2.6 on GQA, − 3.5 -3.5 on TextVQA), confirming that unstructured token removal disrupts critical visual grounding. In contrast, over-retaining anchors (ratio = 1.0) also degrades performance—particularly on TextVQA (56.9 vs. 57.9 at ratio = 0.7), suggesting that excessive token preservation hinders the model’s ability to exploit sparsity and introduces redundant computation without meaningful gains. The optimal trade-off is achieved at an anchor ratio of 0.7, which not only attains peak scores on GQA (60.9), TextVQA (57.9), and POPE (86.6), but also maintains 99.56% of the original model’s effective capacity. This indicates that a moderate yet principled selection of anchor tokens enables MSV-Prune to preserve cross-modal alignment while maximizing computational savings.
blocks.zh: MSV-Prune中Anchor Token比率的偏差(表九)。 我们对锚标比率进行了精细的减压 以描述其对模型性能的影响 结果显示一种明显的非模态趋势:完全失效的锚标(ratio = 0)使所有基准的精确度大幅下降(例如GQA上的− 2.6 - 2.6,TextVQA上的− 3.5 - 3.5),证实无结构的质标清除干扰了关键的视觉地面. 相比之下,过度保留锚(ratio = 1.0)也会降低性能——特别是在TextVQA上(56.9对57.9的比例= 0.7),这表明过份的象征性保存会妨碍模型利用垃圾的能力,引入多余的计算而不产生有意义的收益。 最佳的取舍是在0.7的锚比下实现的,它不仅在GQA(60.9),TextVQA(57.9)和POPE(86.6)上达到最高得分,而且保持了原型有效能力的99.56%. 这表明,适度但有原则地选择锚标使MSV-Prune能够保持跨模式对齐,同时最大限度地节省计算费用。

When ablating 𝐒 f ​ u ​ s ​ e \mathbf{S}_{fuse} in (a), removing the 𝐒 s ​ a \mathbf{S}_{sa} component forces all visual tokens to follow the offline SLC list, while omitting 𝐒𝐋𝐂 \mathbf{SLC} makes skipped tokens bypass entire subsequent layers, leading to higher performance variance and reduced robustness. blocks.en: Ablation on the Balance Between Token Skipping Ratio and Accuracy in ASL-Skip (Figure 9 ). blocks.en: V-G Distribution of High-attention Visual Tokens
blocks.zh: V-G 高视距盒的分布

blocks.en: The visualization of top 50 % \% high-attention tokens across all 24 layers of the CLIP vision encoder, as displayed in Figure 10 , reveals a clear progression in how visual information is processed and represented hierarchically. This hierarchical transformation provides a principled basis for our middle and deep layer selection in the vision encoder: we select the 12 t ​ h 12^{th} layer (middle layer) and the 24 t ​ h 24^{th} layer (final layer) as key feature extraction points.
blocks.zh: 如图10所示,在CLIP视觉编码器的所有24层中,对最高50%的QQ高关注度符号的可视化显示,视觉信息处理和分级表示有明显进展。 这种等级转变为我们在视觉编码器中的中深层选择提供了原则性基础:我们选择了12 t h 12^{th}层(中层)和24 t h 24^{th}层(最后层)作为关键特征提取点.

blocks.en: In the early layers (Layers 1-6), high-attention tokens are evenly distributed across the embedding space, with no strong clustering patterns. This reflects the vision encoder’s initial focus on low-level features, such as edges, textures, and simple shapes—captured at a fine-grained level. These representations are highly local and lack semantic coherence. While rich in detail, they contain too much noise and redundancy for direct use in language modeling, where global semantics and structured concepts are essential.
blocks.zh: 在早期的地层(Layers 1-6)中,高意向符在嵌入空间之间分布均匀,没有强烈的集群模式. 这反映了视觉编码器最初对低层特征的关注,如边缘,纹理,以及简单的形状——在精细的层次上被捕获. 这些表述高度地方性,缺乏语义一致性. 它们虽然细节丰富,但含有过多的噪音和冗余性,可直接用于语言建模,而全球语义和结构化概念是必不可少的。

blocks.en: At Layer 12, we observe a transitional state: the high-attention tokens begin to form distinct clusters while still maintaining some diversity. This indicates that the model has started combining low-level features into higher-level structures, such as object parts or spatial configurations, but without fully collapsing into coarse semantic categories. This makes it an ideal source for capturing the fine-grained object-centric details necessary for more information-dense tasks.
blocks.zh: 在第十二层,我们看到一个过渡状态:高度关注的标志开始形成不同的集群,同时仍然保持一定的多样性. 这表明该模型已经开始将低级特征结合到更高级的结构中,如物体部件或空间配置,但并没有完全崩溃成粗糙的语义类. 这使得它成为捕捉更多信息密集任务所必需的精细的以对象为中心的细节的理想来源.

blocks.en: By Layer 24, the final layer before the output, high-attention tokens exhibit strong clustering, indicating that the vision encoder has synthesized the input into coherent semantic units corresponding to major objects or scene components. The representation becomes highly abstract and globally consistent, emphasizing holistic understanding rather than fine details.
blocks.zh: 按第24层,输出前的最后一层,高意向符号表现出强烈的集群,表明视觉编码器将输入合成了与主要物体或场景组件相对应的连贯语义单元. 这种代表性变得非常抽象,在全球范围是一贯的,强调整体理解而不是细微的细节。

blocks.en: V-I Sensitivity Analysis on Middle Layer Selection
blocks.zh: V-I 中层选择的敏感性分析

blocks.en: To verify that MSV-Prune is robust to the choice of intermediate vision encoder layer, we conduct layer sweep experiments on two architectures: LLaVA-1.5-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, as shown in Figure 11 . For LLaVA-1.5-7B (Figure 11 (a)), we vary the middle layer index from 6 to 18 across the 24-layer CLIP ViT backbone under the 25-30 % \% TFLOPs setting, and observe that both GQA and MMVet scores remain highly stable, fluctuating by less than 0.5 points throughout. For Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct (Figure 11 (b)), a similar sweep from layer 10 to 18 yields equally flat curves on TextVQA and ChartQA, with a variation of less than 0.3 points across all candidate layers. In both cases, performance peaks near the encoder midpoint (layer 12 for LLaVA-1.5-7B and layer 14 for Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct) and degrades only marginally at the extremes: layers that are too shallow lack sufficient semantic abstraction, while layers too close to the final output sacrifice the fine-grained object-centric details that motivate the use of intermediate features. These results confirm that MSV-Prune is not sensitive to the exact middle layer selection, and that adopting around ⌊ L / 2 ⌋ \lfloor L/2\rfloor as the default intermediate layer ID provides a reliable and architecture-agnostic choice that requires no dataset-specific tuning.

blocks.en: Since ASL-Skip uses an offline SLC policy while inference is performed after MSV-Prune, we examine whether token pruning changes the SLC ranking substantially. Table XI shows that the ranking is largely preserved under the pruned token distribution: for both LLaVA-1.5-7B and LLaVA-NeXT-7B, the top-ranked attention and FFN sub-layers exhibit high overlap before and after pruning. Moreover, replacing the original dense-token SLC policy with a pruned-token SLC policy leads to only marginal differences in downstream accuracy. This suggests that the offline SLC captures a stable backbone-level redundancy pattern that remains valid after MSV-Prune.

blocks.en: V-K Failure Case Analysis
blocks.zh: V-K 失败案例分析

blocks.en: Figure 12 illustrates two representative failure cases of the SPIDER framework, revealing critical limitations in its token pruning and sublayer skipping mechanisms under challenging real-world conditions.
blocks.zh: 图12说明了天基信息平台框架的两个具有代表性的失败案例,揭示了其在具有挑战性的现实世界条件下象征性地运行和子层跳过机制的关键局限性。

blocks.en: First, in the license plate recognition task, motion blur introduces severe degradation in image quality, particularly affecting the clarity of individual digits. As shown in the top row of Figure 12 , although the input image contains the correct license plate number ”AED-632”, the retained tokens after SPIDER’s pruning process fail to preserve key character regions. Instead, the model retains ambiguous patches that resemble noise or artifacts, leading it to generate an incorrect answer: ”AH-9899999”. This demonstrates a fundamental issue: SPIDER’s attention-based token selection mechanism, while effective under clean conditions, lacks robustness against low-level image distortions. It tends to prioritize visually salient but semantically irrelevant regions over degraded yet contextually meaningful ones, resulting in hallucinated outputs. The model fails to maintain sufficient fidelity in regions critical for digit parsing, indicating a need for task-aware attention modulation that can adaptively protect high-stakes visual features during compression.
blocks.zh: 首先,在牌照识别任务中,运动模糊性引入了图像质量的严重退化,尤其影响了单个位数的清晰度. 如图12的上行所示,尽管输入图像中包含正确的车牌号 " AED-632 " ,但天基信息平台运行后留存的标志未能保存关键字符区域。 相反,该模型保留了类似噪音或文物的模棱两可的补丁,导致它产生一个错误的答案:“AH-9899999)。 这表明了一个根本问题:天基信息平台基于注意力的象征性选择机制虽然在清洁条件下有效,但缺乏抵御低水平图像扭曲的力度。 它往往将视觉显著但与众无关的区域置于退化但具有关联意义的区域之上,从而产生幻觉。 该模型未能在对数字解析至关重要的区域保持足够的忠心,表明在压缩过程中需要适应性地保护高吸量视觉特征的有任务意识的注意力调制.

blocks.en: Second, in the chest X-ray diagnosis example, the failure arises from sub-layer skipping in clinically relevant regions. As shown in the bottom row of Figure 12 , the reference answer is “Infiltration”, whereas SPIDER predicts “Pneumonia”. The skipped patch tokens, highlighted by the purple masks, overlap with the abnormal region marked by the red box, indicating that critical evidence may be insufficiently updated during decoding. This case suggests that, in medical imaging, indiscriminate compression can distort pathology attribution and lead to clinically misleading predictions. It also highlights the need for domain-aware compression strategies that incorporate anatomical priors or task-specific importance cues to better preserve diagnostically relevant regions.
blocks.zh: 其次,在胸X射线诊断的例子中,故障来自临床相关区域的子层跳转. 如图12的下行所示,参考答案是“渗透”,而天基信息平台预测的是“肺炎”。 以紫色面具突出的跳过补丁符号与红盒标志的异常区域重叠,表明关键证据在解码过程中可能不够更新. 这个案例表明,在医学成像中,不分青红皂白的压缩可以扭曲病理的归属,导致临床上的误导性预测. 报告还强调,需要制定具有域意识的压缩战略,纳入解剖学前科或特定任务的重要性提示,以便更好地保护诊断性相关区域。

blocks.en: To mitigate these issues, future work may explore adaptive token retention policies guided by task semantics. For example, integrating a lightweight semantic segmentation module or using anatomical priors in medical contexts could help preserve critical regions even under aggressive pruning.
blocks.zh: 为缓解这些问题,今后的工作可探索以任务语义为指南的适应性符号保留政策。 例如,将一个轻量级语义分解模块或用解剖学前科在医疗环境中进行整合,即使处于侵略性的挤压下,也可有助于保护关键区域。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: We present SPIDER, a training-free framework that jointly performs multi-layer semantic visual token pruning and adaptive sub-layer skipping in MLLMs. By leveraging redundancy patterns across vision encoder layers and differentiating the roles of Attention and FFNs, SPIDER achieves substantial computational savings with minimal accuracy loss. Experiments across diverse MLLMs and benchmarks show large margins over earlier token-pruning and layer-skipping methods, and parity with the strongest recent baselines at matched compute.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍的是天基信息平台,这是一个无培训框架,它联合执行多层语义视觉符号测试和适应性子层跳过MLLM。 通过利用视觉编码层的冗余模式,并区分注意力和FFN的作用,天基信息平台在尽可能少的准确性损失的情况下实现了大量的计算节约。 跨越各种最低生活水平和基准的实验显示,比早先的代号推算法和分层推算法有很大的幅度,在相应计算时,与最近最强的基准相等。
